text.en:
1A. In these Regulations―

"Principal Registry" means the Principal Registry of High Court in

Kuala Lumpur or the Principal Registry in Kuching, as the case may be.".

Pindaan peraturan 2

3. Peraturan 2 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memotong perkataan

"with the exception of Form B".

Pindaan peraturan 3

4. Peraturan 3 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda―

(a) dengan menggantikan subperaturan (1) dengan subperaturan

yang berikut:

"(1) Upon receipt of a petition for distribution which shall be in

Form A, the Land Administrator shall notify the Principal Registry in any

manner required by the Principal Registry."; dan

(b) dengan memasukkan selepas subperaturan (1) subperaturan yang

berikut:

"(1A) The Land Administrator shall complete Part I of Form B for

record purposes.".

Peraturan baru 3A dan 3B

5. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan selepas peraturan 3

peraturan-peraturan yang berikut:

"Substituted petitioner

3A. (1) In the event that the existing petitioner claiming to be interested in

the said estate as beneficiary dies or is incapable to represent himself due to

critical illness or unsoundness of mind and no distribution order has been made

under subregulation 7(1), any widow, widower or next of kin stated in Form A

may apply to the Land Administrator to substitute the petitioner by filing

Form AA.

(2) Upon receipt of Form AA, the Land Administrator shall notify the

Principal Registry in any manner required by the Principal Registry.

Inclusion of additional name of the deceased

3B. Where it appears that any of the property of the deceased were held

under a name different from the name stated in the proof of death,

the petitioner under section 8 or the applicant under section 17 of the Act shall

provide any necessary documents to satisfy the Land Administrator that the

property forms part of the estate of the deceased in the petition or application.".

Pindaan peraturan 4

6. Peraturan 4 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda―

(a) dengan menggantikan subperaturan (1) dengan subperaturan

yang berikut:

"(1) If upon the expiration of the one month period mentioned

in subregulation 3(2), the result of the search shows that a previous

application has been made, the Land Administrator shall forthwith stay

all proceedings and shall notify the petitioner thereof and of his rights

under subsection 8(9) of the Act."; dan

(b) dalam subperaturan (2), dengan menggantikan perkataan "regulation"

dengan perkataan "subregulation".

Pindaan peraturan 5

7. Subperaturan 5(1) Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan

selepas perkataan "the appropriate" perkataan "High".

Pindaan peraturan 6

8. Peraturan 6 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda―

(a) dalam subperaturan (1)―

(i) dengan memotong perkataan "the form of"; dan

(ii) dengan memotong perkataan "and also at such places of

public resort as the Land Administrator may generally or

in particular cases direct";

(b) dalam subperaturan (2)―

(i) dengan memotong perkataan "prepaid registered"; dan

(ii) memasukkan selepas perkataan "post" perkataan "or by electronic

communication";

(c) dalam subperaturan (3), dengan menggantikan nombor "15" dengan

perkataan "seven"; dan

(d) dalam subperaturan (4)―

(i) dengan memotong perkataan "or any one of the beneficiaries"; dan

(ii) dengan memotong perkataan "or the beneficiary concerned".

Pindaan peraturan 7

9. Peraturan 7 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda―

(a) dalam subperaturan (3), dengan menggantikan perkataan "send notice

thereof to the Registrar, Principal Registry, High Court, Kuala Lumpur or

Kuching, as the case may require, in the Form B by completing all the

particulars required in Part I thereof" dengan perkataan

"immediately notify the petition to the Principal Registry in any manner

required by the Principal Registry";

(b) dengan memasukkan selepas subperaturan (3) subperaturan

yang berikut:

"(3A) The Land Administrator shall complete Part II of Form B

for record purposes."; dan

(c) dengan menggantikan subperaturan (4) dengan subperaturan

yang berikut:

"(4) The Registrar shall cause the particulars to be recorded in

Part II of Form B.".

Pindaan peraturan 9

10. Peraturan 9 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan perkataan

"Assistant Registrar in the appropriate Registry of the High Court" dengan perkataan

"Registrar of the appropriate High Court".

Pindaan peraturan 10

11. Peraturan 10 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda―

(a) dalam perenggan (1)(a), dengan menggantikan perkataan "K2" dengan

perkataan "K1";

(b) dalam perenggan (1)(e), dengan menggantikan perkataan "paragraph (1)"

dengan perkataan "paragraphs 1(a), (b), (c) and (d),";

(c) dalam subperaturan (3)―

(i) dengan menggantikan perkataan "K3" dengan perkataan "K2";

(ii) dengan menggantikan perkataan "K1" dengan perkataan "K3"; dan

(iii) dengan menggantikan perkataan "paragraph" dengan perkataan

"subparagraph";

(d) dalam subperaturan (4)―

(i) dengan menggantikan perkataan "paragraph" di mana-mana jua

terdapat dengan perkataan "subregulation"; dan

(ii) dengan menggantikan perkataan "K1" dengan perkataan "K3";

(e) dalam subperaturan (5)―

(i) dengan memasukkan perkataan "and" di hujung subperenggan (i);

(ii) dengan menggantikan subperenggan (ii) dengan subperenggan

yang berikut:

"(ii) forward to the Registrar of the appropriate High

Court the remaining copies of the record, together

with at least one copy of the memorandum of appeal.

He shall also transmit to the Registrar the sum

deposited under subparagraph (1)(c)(ii) above.";

dan

(iii) dengan memotong subperenggan (5)(iii); dan

(f) dalam subperaturan (7), dengan menggantikan perkataan

"Assistant Registrar" dengan perkataan "Registrar".

Pindaan peraturan 11

12. Peraturan 11 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda―

(a) dalam subperaturan (2), dengan menggantikan perkataan "same and at

such places of public resort as the Land Administrator may generally or in

particular cases direct" dengan perkataan "notice";

(b) dalam subperaturan (3), dengan menggantikan nombor "15" dengan

perkataan "seven"; dan

(c) dalam subperaturan (7), dengan menggantikan perkataan "Order of

distribution" dengan perkataan "Order for distribution".

Pindaan peraturan 12

13. Subperaturan 12(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda―

(a) dengan menggantikan perkataan "regulation" dengan perkataan

"subregulation"; dan

(b) dengan menggantikan nombor "14" dengan perkataan "seven".

Peraturan baru 12A

14. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan selepas peraturan 12

peraturan berikut:

"Correction of error in order

12A. If the order issued under subregulations 7(1) or 12(3) appears to

have any―

(a) clerical error; or

(b) omission as not in accordance with the Land Administrator's

record in writing as specified in section 12 of the Act,

the Land Administrator may at any time make such correction as may be

appropriate in the circumstances of the case.".

Pindaan peraturan 13

15. Peraturan 13 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memotong perkataan

"substantially in the Form U and".

Pindaan peraturan 14

16. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 14 dengan

peraturan berikut:

"Reference by Registrar and direction to transfer

14. (1) Any reference to the Director General of Lands and Mines under

the provisions of subsection 7(2) of the Act and the certificate of the

Director General of Lands and Mines thereon shall be in Form W and Form X

respectively.

(2) Where an estate is certified by the Director General of Lands and

Mines to be a small estate, the Registrar shall transfer the petition in accordance

with subsection 7(1) of the Act.".

Pindaan peraturan 16

17. Subperaturan 16(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dalam proviso dengan

menggantikan perkataan "paragraph" di mana-mana jua terdapat dengan perkataan

"subregulation".

Pindaan peraturan 18

18. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 18 dengan

peraturan yang berikut:

"Regulation 18

18. (1) The fees set out in column 2 of the Second Schedule shall be taken

and paid in respect of all costs, matters and proceedings set out in column 1 of

the Second Schedule.

(2) Notwithstanding subregulation (1), no fee is chargeable if the

deceased died without successor and the estate ordered to be reverted or

transferred to the State Authority or Government as the case may be.".

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

19. Jadual Pertama Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda―

(a) dengan menggantikan perkataan "District Land Administrator"

di mana-mana jua ia terdapat dalam Borang D, Borang DD, Borang E,

Borang EE, Borang F dan Borang HH dengan perkataan "Land

Administrator";

(b) dengan menggantikan perkataan "Regulation" di mana-mana jua ia

terdapat dalam Borang D, Borang DD, Borang E, Borang F, Borang G,

Borang HH, Borang I, Borang L, Borang M, Borang N, Borang Q, Borang R,

Borang S dan Borang T dengan perkataan "Subregulation";

(c) dengan menggantikan perkataan "Section" di mana-mana jua ia terdapat

dalam Borang G, Borang HH, Borang I, Borang Q dan Borang R dengan

perkataan "Subsection";

SMALL ESTATES (DISTRIBUTION) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 30 of

the Small Estates (Distribution) Act 1955 [Act 98], the Minister makes the following

regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the

Small Estates (Distribution) (Amendment) Regulations 2015.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2016.

New regulation 1A

2. The Small Estates (Distribution) Regulations 1955 [L.N. 495 of 1955], which are

referred to as "the principal Regulations" in these Regulations, are amended by

inserting after regulation 1 the following regulation:

"Interpretation

1A. In these Regulations―

"Principal Registry" means the Principal Registry of

High Court in Kuala Lumpur or the Principal Registry in Kuching, as the case

may be.".

Amendment of regulation 2

3. Regulation 2 of the principal Regulations is amended by deleting the words

"with the exception of Form B".

Amendment of regulation 3

4. Regulation 3 of the principal Regulations is amended―

(a) by substituting for subregulation (1) the following subregulation:

"(1) Upon receipt of a petition for distribution which shall be in

Form A, the Land Administrator shall notify the Principal Registry in any

manner required by the Principal Registry."; and

(b) by inserting after subregulation (1) the following subregulation:

"(1A) The Land Administrator shall complete Part I of Form B for

record purposes.".

New regulations 3A and 3B

5. The principal Regulations are amended by inserting after regulation 3 the

following regulations:

"Substituted petitioner

3A. (1) In the event that the existing petitioner claiming to be interested in

the said estate as beneficiary dies or is incapable to represent himself due to

critical illness or unsoundness of mind and no distribution order has been made

under subregulation 7(1), any widow, widower or next of kin stated in Form A

may apply to the Land Administrator to substitute the petitioner by filing

Form AA.

(2) Upon receipt of Form AA, the Land Administrator shall notify the

Principal Registry in any manner required by the Principal Registry.

Inclusion of additional name of the deceased

3B. Where it appears that any of the property of the deceased were held

under a name different from the name stated in the proof of death,

the petitioner under section 8 or the applicant under section 17 of the Act shall

provide any necessary documents to satisfy the Land Administrator that the

property forms part of the estate of the deceased in the petition or application.".

Amendment of regulation 4

6. Regulation 4 of the principal Regulations is amended―

(a) by substituting for subregulation (1) the following subregulation:

"(1) If upon the expiration of the one month period mentioned

in subregulation 3(2), the result of the search shows that a previous

application has been made, the Land Administrator shall forthwith stay

all proceedings and shall notify the petitioner thereof and of his rights

under subsection 8(9) of the Act."; and

(b) in subregulation (2), by substituting for the word "regulation" the word

"subregulation".

Amendment of regulation 5

7. Subregulation 5(1) of the principal Regulations is amended by inserting after the

words "the appropriate" the word "High".

Amendment of regulation 6

8. Regulation 6 of the principal Regulations is amended―

(a) in subregulation (1)―

(i) by deleting the words "the form of"; and

(ii) by deleting the words "and also at such places of public resort as

the Land Administrator may generally or in particular cases

direct";

(b) in subregulation (2)―

(i) by deleting the words "prepaid registered"; and

(ii) by inserting after the word "post" the words "or by electronic

communication";

(c) in subregulation (3), by substituting for the number "15" the word

"seven"; and

(d) in subregulation (4)―

(i) by deleting the words "or any one of the beneficiaries"; and

(ii) by deleting the words "or the beneficiary concerned".

Amendment of regulation 7

9. Regulation 7 of the principal Regulations is amended―

(a) in subregulation (3), by substituting for the words "send notice thereof to

the Registrar, Principal Registry, High Court, Kuala Lumpur or Kuching,

as the case may require, in the Form B by completing all the particulars

required in Part I thereof" the words "immediately notify the petition to

the Principal Registry in any manner required by the Principal Registry";

"(3A) The Land Administrator shall complete Part II of Form B

for record purposes."; and

(c) by substituting for subregulation (4) the following subregulation:

"(4) The Registrar shall cause the particulars to be recorded in

Part II of Form B.".

Amendment of regulation 9

words "Assistant Registrar in the appropriate Registry of the High Court" the words

"Registrar of the appropriate High Court".

Amendment of regulation 10

11. Regulation 10 of the principal Regulations is amended―

(a) in paragraph (1)(a), by substituting for the word "K2" the word "K1";

New regulation 12A

14. The principal Regulations are amended by inserting after regulation 12 the

following regulation:

"Correction of error in order

12A. If the order issued under subregulations 7(1) and 12(3) appears to have

any―

(a) clerical error; or

Amendment of regulation 14

"Reference by Registrar and direction to transfer

14. (1) Any reference to the Director General of Lands and Mines under

respectively.

(2) Where an estate is certified by the Director General of Lands and

Amendment of regulation 16

Amendment of regulation 18

18. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 18 the

following regulation―

"Regulation 18

18. (1) The fees set out in column 2 of the Second Schedule shall be taken

and paid in respect of all costs, matters and proceedings set out in column 1 of

the Second Schedule.

(2) Notwithstanding subregulation (1), no fee is chargeable if the

deceased died without successor and the estate ordered to be reverted or

transferred to the State Authority or Government as the case may be.".
